name: Groupe Flo SA
summary: Groupe Flo SA engages in the restaurant business in France and internationally. As of May 30, 2019, it operated 178 restaurants, including 91 owned and 87 franchised under the names of Hippopotamus, Maître Kanter's Taverne, and Bistro Romain; 25 breweries comprising 5 owned and 9 franchised under the names of Le Vaudeville, Bofinger, Le Balzar, Le Boeuf sur le Toit, and La Coupole; and 13 restaurants under the Disneyland Paris, Jardin des Plantes in Paris, and CNIT in La Défense names. The company was founded in 1968 and is based in Courbevoie, France.
